wizard.welcome.subtitle:
Capture your screen and instantly get
a link you can paste anywhere.
wizard.welcome.no_account_hint: Links last 6 hours, up to 5 captures a day.
wizard.connect.title: Connect Google Drive
wizard.connect.body:
Snap2Link needs access to your Google Drive
to store your screenshots.

A 'Snap2Link' folder will be created automatically.
wizard.connect.browser_hint: A browser window will open. Grant access, then return here.
wizard.success.ready:
Snap2Link is ready.
The icon appears in the taskbar.
It will start with your computer.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.capture.desc: What each shortcut does, from the key press to the copied link.
settings.capture.error.duplicate_hotkey: This combination is already used by another shortcut.
settings.capture.error.hotkey_unavailabl: This combination is taken by another application. Try another one.
settings.capture.error.invalid_hotkey: This combination can't be used as a shortcut.
settings.mode.ask.help: Opens on the last mode you used. Change it with R, F or W.
settings.mode.region.help: You draw the frame with the mouse.
settings.mode.full_screen.help: The screen under the mouse, with nothing to select.
settings.mode.active_window.help: The window in front, with nothing to select.
settings.after.ask.help: Snap2Link offers to edit or share the capture.
settings.after.share.help: The link is created and copied without asking.
settings.after.share.warning: The link is public and created without a preview. If your screen shows something private, anyone with the link can see it. The “Link copied” message lets you delete the capture right away.
settings.after.annotate.help: The annotator opens. The link is created when you confirm.
settings.memory.title: Last choice
settings.memory.desc: With “Ask”, your last choice is preselected. Nothing is shared without your confirmation.
settings.hosting.desc: Only the options of the chosen host are shown.
settings.hosting.drive_card: Your Google account. Captures stay in your Drive.
settings.hosting.plan_hint: 5 captures a day, up to 5 MB each. Accounts and more captures are coming.
settings.hosting.link_life_hint: After this delay, the link stops working and the capture is erased.
settings.hosting.connect_hint: Connect your account to send captures to your Drive.
settings.hosting.account_hint: Captures are sent to this account.
settings.hosting.folder_hint: Captures use your Google storage, with no Snap2Link limit.
settings.hosting.auto_delete_on: Old captures are removed from your Drive.
settings.hosting.auto_delete_off: Captures stay in your Drive until you delete them.
settings.hosting.keep_hint: After this delay, the capture leaves your Drive and its link stops working.
settings.hosting.access_title: Anyone with the link can see the capture
settings.hosting.access_hint: The rest of your Drive is not shared.
settings.general.desc: How the application behaves on this computer.
settings.general.startup_hint: Snap2Link waits in the notification area.
settings.general.notify_hint: With a Delete button to remove the capture right away.
settings.general.language_hint: By default, your system's language. English if it isn't available.
about.description: Capture your screen and instantly get a link you can paste anywhere.
about.author: Author
overlay.hint: Select an area  •  ESC to cancel
overlay.mode.hint: R region  •  F full screen  •  W window  •  ESC cancel
overlay.fullscreen.subtitle: Click anywhere to capture, or pick another mode above.
overlay.window.title: Pick a window
overlay.window.subtitle: Click a window to capture it.
overlay.prompt.title: What now?
overlay.prompt.hint: E to edit  •  S to save  •  Enter to confirm  •  ESC to cancel
uploader.title: Uploading your capture
uploader.subtitle: Hold tight, the link is on its way to your clipboard.
uploader.success.title: Link copied!
uploader.success.subtitle: The screenshot link is in your clipboard.
uploader.deleted.title: Capture deleted
uploader.deleted.subtitle: The link no longer works.
uploader.delete_failed.title: Could not delete the capture
uploader.delete_failed.subtitle: The link still works. Try again.
uploader.error.daily_limit: Daily limit reached: 5 captures a day without an account.
uploader.error.service_busy: Snap2Link hosting is busy right now. Try again later.
uploader.error.too_large: This capture is too large for Snap2Link hosting (5 MB maximum).
uploader.error.unreachable: Snap2Link hosting can't be reached. Check your connection.
uploader.error.drive_not_connected: Google Drive isn't connected. Connect it in the settings.
uploader.error.verification_cancelled: Check cancelled. It's needed once to use Snap2Link hosting.
uploader.error.verification_failed: The security check failed. Try again, or switch to Google Drive in the settings.
uploader.error.banned: This install can no longer use Snap2Link hosting. Switch to Google Drive in the settings.
oauth.success.title: Google Drive connected!
oauth.success.body:
You can close this tab
and return to Snap2Link.
oauth.failure.title: Google Drive was not connected
oauth.failure.body: Sign-in was cancelled. You can close this tab and try again from Snap2Link.
